The 'cloudy eyes' are likely a symptom of this geometric uncertainty/fusion rather than just cataracts. The background pattern bleeding into the paws is also a sign of topological fusion, not just DOF blur. The perceptual quality auditor missed these structural issues because it only looks for graphic distortions.
